name: pg_grammar_guard
abstract: Compile a token-level grammar from your live catalog, and watch it for drift
description: pg_grammar_guard compiles a GBNF grammar from the identifiers in your live catalog, so a constrained language model cannot emit a table, column or value that doesn't exist. Approve a grammar once and it reports when the schema has drifted away from it. Pure SQL, no shared library.

pg_grammar_guard.abstract: Generate a grammar from the live catalog and detect when it drifts
